name: Peanut-Coconut Tofu Curry with Zucchini, Tomato & Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in another medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chopped veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 3 minutes.
When the veggies are softened, add coconut milk, peanut butter, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, and soy sauce to the pot. Stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer.

Once the curry is simmering, add tofu and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and curry has thickened slightly, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from heat.
While the curry is cooking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower, water, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the cauliflower rice is done, remove from heat, add cilantro, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
